intro: Some skills have an action type assigned to them. This determines how skills interact with each other, and whether or not they succeed against other skills. For example, your Rush skills beat enemy Guard skills.

types.name: Attack
types.help:
Attack is a simple and versatile skill that is the basis of close combat. There is no casting time, or cooldown time like with other skills.

Advantage against: Rush skills

Disadvantage against: Spin, Guard, Counter, and Long Range Skills

types.name: Spin
types.help:
Spin is a type of attack that strikes surrounding enemies and knocks them back. Spin does not target specific enemies, and can be activated as long as any enemies are in range. Usage of Spin skills consumes HP, the user cannot move while casting them, and activation will result in a cooldown timer.

Advantages against :Attack and Counter skills.

Disadvantage against: Guard and Long Range skills.

types.name: Rush
types.help:
Rush is a powerful attack type that breaks the opponents guard and deals increased damage. Using rush skills consumed HP. Rush skills have cast times, but very short cooldown times.

Advantage against: Guard skills.

Disadvantage against: Attack and Counter skills.

types.name: Shot
types.help:
Shot is the most basic method of firearm combat and consumes bullets when performed. While you can attack from a distance, there is a limit to how far away you can fire from. There is a cast time, but little to no cooldown time depending on the skill.

Advantages against: Attack, Spin, Guard, and Counter skills.

Disadvantages against: Dodge skills.
types.also:
Destruction Magic is a combat method that attacks the enemy from a distance and consumes MP when used. You can move while casting spells, and when the spell is ready to be used, but cannot cast spells if you do not have enough MP or are too far away from the enemy. Destruction Magic is subject to casting times and cooldown times.

Advantages against: Attack, Spin, Guard, and Counter skills.

Disadvantages against: Dodge skills.

types.name: Rapid
types.help:
Rapid is a method of attack that fires a series of shots from a long distance and consumes both bullets and MP. When the casting time has finished you will automatically enter the Rapid stance and be unable to move. Your MP will gradually decrease while you are in the stance. Rapid skills are subject to both casting times and cooldown times.

Advantages against: Attack, Spin, Guard, and Counter skills.

Disadvantages against: Dodge skills.

types.name: Guard
types.help:
Guard is a defensive skill that in fundamental in preventing enemy attacks. Guard reduces incoming damage from enemy Attack and Spin skills, and stuns your opponent. However, if you are hit by a Rush or Long Range skills, your guard will be cancelled and you will take damage. While guarding, your movement is slowed. Guard is subject to a casting time, but does not have a cooldown time.

Advantages against: Attack and Spin skills.

Disadvantages against: Rush and Long Range Attacks.

types.name: Counter
types.help:
Counter is a defensive skill that nullifies an enemy attack and deals damage in turn. If you are Attacked or Rushed by an enemy, it will nullify the damage and deal damage to the enemy at the same time. However, if you are attacked with a Spin skill or Long Range attack, the counter will not activate and you will take damage. You cannot move while in the counter attack stance, and your MP will gradually decrease. Counter is subject to both casting times and cooldown times.

Advantages against: Attack and Rush skills.

Disadvantages against: Spin and Long Range Attack skills.

types.name: Dodge
types.help:
Dodge is a defensive skill that allows you to avoid Long Range attacks and create an opening to attack. You cannot move while in the dodge stance, and dodge skills are subject to casting times and cooldown times.

Advantage against: Long-Range Attacks (Ex. Shot and Magic Skills)

Disadvantages against: Melee attacks.

types.name: Talk
types.help: Use "Talk," "Intimidate," or "Provoke" skills to negotiate with demons. It's important to change your negotiation methods with different demons to get their interest.

types.name: Threaten
types.help: Use "Talk," "Intimidate," or "Provoke" skills to negotiate with demons. It's important to change your negotiation methods with different demons to get their interest.

types.name: Provoke
types.help: Use "Talk," "Intimidate," or "Provoke" skills to negotiate with demons. It's important to change your negotiation methods with different demons to get their interest.

types.name: Curative
types.help: Curative magic includes spells that restore HP and cure abnormalities. MP is consumed when using these spells, and spells cannot be cast if you do not have enough MP or are too far away from an ally or partner demon. Curative spells are subject to both casting times and cooldown times.
types.also:
Support Magic is a type of magic the improves an allies' abilities temporarily, and consumes MP when performed. You can move while casting Support magic, but the skills cannot be used if too far away from allies or a partner demon. Support Magic is subject to both casting times and cooldown times.

Some Support Magic can stack up to four times.
types.also2:
Curse Magic involves spells that temporarily weaken an enemy and consume MP when performed. You can move while casting Support magic, but the skills cannot be used if too far away from an enemy. Curse Magic is subject to both casting times and cooldown times.

Some Curse Magic can be avoid with Dodge.

Disadvantages against: Dodge skills.

types.name: Passive
types.help: Passive skills go into effect as long as they are learned.

types.name: Switch
types.help: Switch skills can be toggled on and off.

skills.name: Crystallize Demon
skills.desc:
A secret art that fuses summoned demons
with certain jewels to create Demon
Crystals.

When successful, the demon is lost, but
a Demon Crystal is acquired in its stead.
When unsuccessful, the jewel is lost and
the Friendship level with the demon
drops.

*Cannot be performed if friendship
 with demon is low.

skills.name: Tarot Fusion
skills.desc:
A secret art that fuses the power 
contained within Demon Crystals
and Tarot Cards with equipment.

When successful, the crystal or card
is lost, but the equipment acquires 
special powers.
When unsuccessful, the equipment's 
Durability decreases. 

*Cannot be performed on items with 
0 Durability or items currently being
equipped.

skills.name: Soul Stone Fusion
skills.desc:
With this secret art, you can fuse
Demon Crystals and Soul Stones
together with Equipment.

When successful, both the crystal
and stone is lost but a special
power is added to the Equipment.
When unsuccessful, the Equipment's
durability is decreased and both
the crystal and stone is lost.
(Note: Cannot be performed with items
that have a durability of 0)

skills.name: Glow of a Thousand Magics
skills.desc:
A special skill that evokes the power sleeping
within a quietly glowing ring to emit a burst
of teal flame.

Deals Mystic-baded damage against 
all enemies in an
area in front of the user, with the damage
based on the user's Spell.

Modifier: 250 | Stiffness: 980

skills.name: Deadly Smile
skills.desc:
Increases the user's Rush, Spin, Shot and Rapid
damage for 10 seconds based on the user's level.

skills.name: Whisper of Temptation
skills.desc: tantalizing sensual appeal

skills.name: Absolute Ice
skills.desc:
Freezes liquid in the air at an extreme
temperature, increasing the attack power
of player and partner's ice-type attacks
by ice stimulation.

skills.name: NEMISSA
skills.desc:
A spell that completely gives damage
of the almighty to all enemies by
unleashing light.
Incantation cannot be interrupted
with damagebut can be interrupted 
with knock-back.

Modifier: 75 | Stiffness: 980

skills.desc:

Demon Goldfish. Delivers some damage
to the enemy.

Modifier: 10 | Stiffness: 750

skills.name: Goldfish Scoop X
skills.desc:

Demon Goldfish. Delivers more damage
than the Goldfish Scoop skill.

Modifier: 15 | Stiffness: 750

skills.name: Reincarnation
skills.desc:
A spell that completely resuscitates a dead ally 
by unleashing a light that restores their soul, flesh and mind.
Ally suffers no XP reduction.
Incantation cannot be interrupted with damage,
but can be interrupted with knock-back.

Modifier: 100 | Stiffness: 980

skills.name: DMC
skills.desc:
Heaven and hell revolve around you.
Should any demon block your path,
they shall immediately be destroyed.
Delivers massive damage to opponent,
but greatly reduces weapon Durability.

Modifier: 9999 | Stiffness: 1000

skills.name: Illusion Break
skills.desc:
A skill based on the ability to destroy
any type of special ability.
Nulls certain types of attacks for
10 seconds while, for some reason,
making the user unhappy.

skills.name: Shadow Vanish
skills.desc:
A technique for hiding one's self in
the shadows to avoid enemy targeting.
Can only be used between 6PM and 5:59AM.

*MP gradually decreases while in use.

skills.name: Great Cleanse
skills.desc:
Returns all into a state of nothingness.
Inflicts almighty-based damage on
a single enemy and all enemies near it.

Modifier: 100 | Stiffness: 750

skills.name: Mass Taunt
skills.desc:
Provokes all nearby enemies into
focusing all their rage onto one's
self. The provoked enemies will
experience a Foul Mood.

skills.name: Revitalize Low
skills.desc: Use Magnetite to temporarily strengthen your demon. *Effect is overridden when the same skill or Revitalize High which has higher effect is used.

skills.name: Revitalize High
skills.desc: Use Philosopher's Stone to temporarily strengthen your demon. *Effect is overridden when the same skill is used.

skills.name: Pulse Impact
skills.desc:
Focus all the psychic power and create an explosion. Inflicts weapon-based damage to all surrounding enemies.

Modifier: 50 | Stiffness: 980

skills.name: Palm Blast
skills.desc:
Full-power palm strike will stun the enemy which makes it easy to execute a combo attack. Damage will not affect spell casting but knock back can.

Modifier: 10 | Stiffness: 1000

Fire multiple beams and inflict weapon-based damage to a target and all the surrounding enemies.

Modifier: 25 | Stiffness: 750

skills.name: Curse of Bael

Use Magnetite to embody the force
and emit.
Inflicts weapon-based damage
to all enemies between the user 
and the target.

Modifier: 75 | Stiffness: 1000

skills.desc:

with the force of a malevolent deity.

Inflicts damage to all enemies in the vicinity
based on the users CLS-R, LNG-R and Mystic stats.

Modifier: 300 | Stiffness: 750

skills.name: Palm Blast Type 2
skills.desc:
全身全霊を込めた掌底による打撃で
敵の威厳を砕く特殊スキル。

敵1体に対して、
ＬＶと、力～運の能力値を
最大で合計1000まで加味し、
補助効果量に依存した
魔法ダメージを与える。

更に、対象に50秒間、
継続ダメージを与えると共に、
・Critical Defense -500
・Ailment Resist -50
・HP Regeneration が0になる
以上の状態変化を付与する。

このスキルは、
ダメージによって詠唱を中断されず、
ノックバックによって詠唱を止められる。

なお、このスキルに対して
ガードやカウンターの効果を受けない。

Modifier: 150 | Stiffness: 1000

skills.name: Encouragement of a Hero
skills.desc:
A special skill that grants the Encouragment of a
Hero, increasing the number of times you can act.

All party members around the user are granted a
status that grants 2 stacks to all skills.

The effect ends with:
・Death
・Logout
・Storing your demon (only the demon)
If skills with similar effects are used,
the effect will be overwritten.

skills.name: Selfless Wail
skills.desc:
地割れを引き起こす程に、
壮絶な破壊を引き起こす特殊スキル。

使用者の周囲にいる敵に対して、
ＬＶと、力～運の能力値を
最大で合計1000まで加味し、
装備している武器の攻撃力に依存した
物理ダメージを与える。

Modifier: 100 | Stiffness: 750

skills.name: 美麗陣・Godspeed
skills.desc:
見たものを魅了する艶やかな体捌きにより、
使用者が非常に素早くダッジ状態になり、
ショット、ラピッドを回避する特殊スキル。

更に、低確率で攻撃してきた敵1体に
対して3～6秒間、
美麗陣の状態変化を付与する。

skills.name: Vermillion of Solid
skills.desc:
A special skill that grants
the blessing of Avians.

For 5 minutes, the user and party members
receive the following benefits:
・Close-Range, Long-Range, Spell Damage Taken -20%
・Critical Defense +100
・When HP is 2 or greater, 20% chance of surviving a lethal blow
skills.cost: 30 MP, 50 × Orb of the Southern Roc

skills.name: Break Shooter
skills.desc:
弾丸に生体マグネタイトの
エネルギーを込めて撃ち放つ特殊スキル。

1度の詠唱で2発分の装填を行い、
自分自身、もしくは、
他プレイヤーに対して、
インテンシブ・ブレイクの状態変化を
1発で4回分付与する。

この効果は、
最大で100回まで重ねて適用されるが、
1発目に付与されたタイミングから
20秒後に消失する。

このスキルは、詠唱完了後の待機中に、
ＭＰが徐々に減少する。

skills.name: Break Shooter (Demon)
skills.desc:
弾丸に生体マグネタイトの
エネルギーを込めて撃ち放つ特殊スキル。

1度の詠唱で2発分の装填を行い、
自分自身の仲魔、もしくは、
他プレイヤーの仲魔に対して、
インテンシブ・ブレイクの状態変化を
1発で4回分付与する。

この効果は、
最大で100回まで重ねて適用されるが、
1発目に付与されたタイミングから
20秒後に消失する。

このスキルは、詠唱完了後の待機中に、
ＭＰが徐々に減少する。

skills.name: Out of Darkness
skills.desc:
A special skill in which 
a purple pillar rising from the abyss 
brings an end to all.

The user deals Spell-based Almighty 
Damage to enemies around them.

It also applies [Horror] status to
all targets for 5 seconds.

Modifier: 1050 | Stiffness: 2500

skills.name: Infinite Light
skills.desc:
収束した魔光から光を拡散する魔法。

使用者の周囲にいる敵に対して、
近接攻撃力、射撃攻撃力、魔法効果量の
全てを加味した魔法ダメージを与える。

このスキルは、
クールタイムが『無尽無辺光』と
同期して扱われ、
ダメージによって詠唱を中断されず、
ノックバックによって詠唱を止められる。

Modifier: 100 | Stiffness: 2500

skills.desc:
軍荼利明王の呪を込めて放つ特技。

弾丸の相性に関係なく神経相性になり、
敵1体に対して、
射撃攻撃力に、魔法効果量の50%を
上乗せした、物理ダメージを与える。

更に、低確率で対象に30～45秒間、
盲目の状態変化を付与する。

Changes bullet to Almighty-based.

targets and applies an unblockable debuff that 
increases the targets' Long-range damage 
taken by 10% per shot 
(50% at max stack).

直線上の敵全員に対して、
魔法効果量に、近接攻撃力の50%を
上乗せした、魔法ダメージを与える。

更に、低確率で対象に12秒間、
封魔の状態変化を付与する。

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.desc:
A switch skill that specializes in defense.

[Plus Effect]
. VIT +15
. Counter Boost + (VIT x 0.5)%
. When using Maelstrom, 
gains 2 stack of [Protective Vortex], 
up to 10 stacks.
. When using Three Step Crescent Moon,
gain a stack of [Protective Vortex]
Protective Vortex lasts for 15 seconds.
. When damaged by an enemy, chance to 
trigger [Protective Vortex] +10%
. When Undying Soul is also active, 
[Protective Vortex] trigger chance 
is additionally increased by +25%

[Minus Effect]
. LNG-R, Spell and Support 
Damage -50%
. Max MP -10%

[Protective Vortex]
. CLS-R, LNG-R and Magic 
Damage suffered -5% per stack.
. Lifesteal Chance +2%,
Lifesteal Power +2% per stack

[Ability Boost]

Spd, Lck increased 
(Every 15 Support Stat = +1,
Capped at +100)

skills.name: Impulse of Armored
skills.desc:
Magic that makes every beat of your heart 
fill you with bravery, giving your body a resolve
that doesn't know retreat. 

To nearby party members for 30 seconds:
. Temporarily cancels knockback from received 
attacks
. LB Power +15%
. TA Power +15%

While Radiant Hands is active, the improved 
version of the buff additionally grants
-15% General Damage Received,
additional +15% LB Power, TA Power
and lasts for 30 minutes.

skills.name: Corrosion Hex
skills.desc:
A curse that eats at the body and 
soul of surrounding enemies, 
and has a low probability of 
inflicting various adverse effects.
When Lord of Malevolence is active,
using this skill will grant the 
user a stack of [Cursebearer].

Modifier: 75 | Stiffness: 1000
exp: Curse of the Wretched · Class 7 Rank 0

skills.name: Curse of the Four Wounds
skills.desc:
A curse that reduces 
elemental resistances of 
surrounding enemies by 50% 
for 30 seconds. 

When Lord of Malevolence is 
active, the curse also
removes Null, Reflect and Absorb for 
Mystic, Nerve, Mind, Death affinities 
to the target, 
and also lowers their resistance of
those affinities by 150%
for 30 seconds.
exp: Curse of the Wretched · Class 8 Rank 0

skills.name: Soul of Pursuit: Extreme
skills.desc:
Passive skill.

・Pursuit power +10%
.LB power +10%
　※The upper limit of Pursuit power is 100%

skills.name: Summon Lesson 2
skills.desc:
A superior summoning technique.
Passive Skill that raises Summoning Speed. 

・Summoning Speed +30%

skills.name: Intimidate
skills.desc:
A negotiation skill that threatens the opponent
to obey.

If successful, it will greatly raise the
obedience level of the target.

skills.name: Spear
skills.desc:
その名の通り、槍の如き鋭さを持った
体当たりを敵へとぶつける特技。

直線上の敵全員に対して、
近接攻撃力に依存した
物理ダメージを与える。

Modifier: 250 | Stiffness: 980

skills.name: Magic Blast
skills.desc:
A special skill 
that fires out a powerful blast of magic.

Causes magic damage to the enemy 
and their surroundings,
depending on the user's Magic.

Modifier: 150 | Stiffness: 1200

skills.name: Bloodsucker
skills.desc:
敵の血を噴出させ、自らのものとする特技。

敵1体に対して、
魔法効果量に依存した
魔法ダメージを与えると共に、
対象のＭＰにもダメージを与え、
自身のHP、ＭＰが
ダメージの50%分回復する。

Modifier: 90 | Stiffness: 750

skills.name: Mega Strike
skills.desc:
精神力を高めて爆発が伴う突撃を行う特技。

対象と、その周囲の敵に対して、
近接攻撃力に、魔法効果量の50%を
上乗せした、物理ダメージを与える。

Modifier: 250 | Stiffness: 2000

skills.name: Nervous Edge
skills.desc:
使用者の周囲に
不快に感じる気を発する魔法。

使用者の周囲にいる敵に対して、
魔法効果量に依存した
魔法ダメージを与える。

更に、高確率で対象に18～24秒間、
緊縛の状態変化を付与する。

Modifier: 230 | Stiffness: 980

skills.name: Thread of the Forest
skills.desc:
静寂で穏やかな憎悪を敵にぶつける特技。

直線上の敵全員に対して、
射撃攻撃力に依存した
物理ダメージを与える。

このスキルは、
ダメージによって詠唱を中断されず、
ノックバックによって詠唱を止められる。

Modifier: 330 | Stiffness: 2000

skills.name: Corona Cannon
skills.desc:
全てを灰燼に帰す火炎弾を撃ち出す特技。

敵1体に対して、
魔法効果量に、射撃攻撃力の50%を
上乗せした、魔法ダメージを与える。

弾速が遅く、着弾までに時間がかかる。

Modifier: 210 | Stiffness: 1500

skills.name: Blizzard Cannon
skills.desc:
絶対零度の氷結弾を撃ち出す特技。

敵1体に対して、
魔法効果量に、射撃攻撃力の50%を
上乗せした、魔法ダメージを与える。

弾速が遅く、着弾までに時間がかかる。

Modifier: 190 | Stiffness: 1500

skills.name: Lightning Cannon
skills.desc:
地を這う閃光の電撃弾を撃ち出す特技。

敵1体に対して、
魔法効果量に、射撃攻撃力の50%を
上乗せした、魔法ダメージを与える。

弾速が遅く、着弾までに時間がかかる。

Modifier: 180 | Stiffness: 1500

skills.name: Hurricane Cannon
skills.desc:
全てを切り裂く衝撃弾を撃ち出す特技。

敵1体に対して、
魔法効果量に、射撃攻撃力の50%を
上乗せした、魔法ダメージを与える。

弾速が遅く、着弾までに時間がかかる。

Modifier: 170 | Stiffness: 1500

skills.name: Magic Burst
skills.desc:
A spell that drops meteorites made of magic.
Causes mystic damage to enemies around the user, 
dependent on Spell stat.
Also has a high chance to increase the targets'
cooldown and incantation time by 100% for 
30 seconds,and a low chance to paralyze 
the targets for 18-24 seconds.

Modifier: 190 | Stiffness: 350

skills.name: Heaven Shaking Sword
skills.desc:
A special skill that
releases the Heaven Shaking Sword 
ultimate sword skil.

Causes physical damage to all enemies
around the user.

At max stacks of 
[Rampaging Whirlwind]: 
. If [At World’s End] is active, 
refreshes [At World’s End] 
duration by 30 seconds.

. If Serpent Coil is learnt, 
using Heaven Shaking Sword
grants [Serpent Coil].

When Limit Break Up: Strength
(Crushing Tech Class 10-0) and
Gale Form are active,
deals additional (Crit x 1) LB Cap
Damage.

Modifier: 320 | Stiffness: 750
